question: Which three years in 2012-2017 have the smallest absolute difference between median revenue and median functional expenses for organizations filing IRS 990 forms? Please output three years and respective differences.
sql:
WITH combined AS (
  SELECT 
    SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(tax_pd, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS year,
    totrevenue,
    totfuncexpns
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2012`
  WHERE SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(tax_pd, 1, 4) AS INT64) BETWEEN 2012 AND 2017
    AND totrevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    DIV(tax_pd, 100) AS year,
    totrevenue,
    totfuncexpns
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2013`
  WHERE tax_pd BETWEEN 201201 AND 201799
    AND totrevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    DIV(tax_pd, 100) AS year,
    totrevenue,
    totfuncexpns
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2014`
  WHERE tax_pd BETWEEN 201201 AND 201799
    AND totrevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    DIV(tax_pd, 100) AS year,
    totrevenue,
    totfuncexpns
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2015`
  WHERE tax_pd BETWEEN 201201 AND 201799
    AND totrevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    DIV(tax_pd, 100) AS year,
    totrevenue,
    totfuncexpns
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2016`
  WHERE tax_pd BETWEEN 201201 AND 201799
    AND totrevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    DIV(tax_pd, 100) AS year,
    totrevenue,
    totfuncexpns
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2017`
  WHERE tax_pd BETWEEN 201201 AND 201799
    AND totrevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
),
medians AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(totrevenue, 0.5) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS median_revenue,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(totfuncexpns, 0.5) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS median_expenses
  FROM combined
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
  year,
  median_revenue,
  median_expenses,
  ABS(median_revenue - median_expenses) AS abs_diff
FROM medians
ORDER BY abs_diff ASC
LIMIT 3
